sessions.summary: Code review PR #189 (CXCDP-43572): CoreHandler DI wiring, CoreBackup class, ReadBackup helper for ApplicationUpgrade V2. Ran two-axis mattpocock code review (Standards + Spec) plus two specialist agents (Orleans + Security). Found 2 spec violations (EnrichmentPoints wrong type—data-integrity bug; PollingConfigurations collection type mismatch), 2 standards findings (dead Failure() helper, comment noise), 4 advisory findings (Orleans/security). REQUEST_CHANGES posted to GitHub.

Code review PR #192 (doc-only: Visibility field + PersistenceGate decision on ApplicationUpgrade epic). Ran mattpocock-skills:code-review two-axis review. Standards found 2 findings (duplicated Visibility type, Divergent Change). Spec found 3 findings (undeclared file, test coverage gaps, missing comment). 3 review comments posted to PR #192 via gh CLI.

Security audit (SDOL-011) of Ontology Editor codebase: 9-area review covering JWT auth layer, API endpoints, HANA SQL patterns, SPARQL construction, AI Core prompts, external connectors, frontend XSS surface, and existing security controls. Key findings: auth solid (parameterized SQL, XSUAA, role Depends); MCP_AUTH_DISABLED lacks CF production guard; /query/sparql endpoint lacks rate limiting and complexity cap; SPARQL FILTER escaping incomplete; user input injected raw into NL-to-SPARQL LLM prompt. Audit artifact saved to docs/documents/security/SDOL-011-security-audit.md.

SDOL-011 secure-coding-guidelines PR: copied secure-coding-guidelines.md from narwhal-sdol to docs/documents/security/; created branch SDOL-011/secure-coding-guidelines on dev-velocity; opened PR on github.wdf.sap.corp. Addressed 4 review comments: validate_host_endpoint SSRF protection (scheme enforcement + IP range blocking), Section 8 /health disclosure rows, CORS config notes. Polish commit with improved comments. All commits pushed; PR reply posting manual-only (github-tools MCP host mismatch).
